rule: Founder names publish only with the company's own page, or two independent reputable sources, or Endeavor plus one more; aggregators never count.

gojek.note: Go-Jek was founded in 2010 by Nadiem Makarim, Michaelangelo Moran and Kevin Aluwi, per Detik, Kumparan and GoTo; Kumparan dates the start to October 2010. GoTo was formed in May 2021 by the merger of Gojek and Tokopedia. CNBC Indonesia also describes Andre Soelistyo, a central figure in that merger, as a co-founder of GoTo; he is not listed because these sources credit Gojek's 2010 founding to the three named here.

ajaib.note: Founded in 2019 by Anderson Sumarli and Yada Piyajomkwan, per Forbes and investor Y Combinator; Ajaib's own site gives the 2019 date.

triv.note: Founded by Gabriel Rey, per Triv's own blog; Media Indonesia says Triv has operated since 2015.

cashlez.note: Founded in 2015 by Teddy Setiawan Tee (also written Tee Teddy Setiawan), per SWA, Kontan and iNews and his own profile.

fazz.note: Payfazz, the Indonesian company behind FAZZ, was founded by Hendra Kwik, per FAZZ's site; Ricky Winata is listed as a founder by Y Combinator and on his own profile. Y Combinator also lists Jefriyanto as a founder and gives 2017 as the founding year, while MUFG Innovation Partners gives 2016. FAZZ was formed in 2021 when Payfazz merged with Xfers, which Tianwei Liu founded.

qoala.note: Founded in 2017 as Lumen by Harshet Lunani and Tommy Martin, per Qoala's milestones page; it rebranded as Qoala in 2019.

shipper.note: Founded by Budi Handoko and Phil Opamuratawongse, per Bisnis, Medcom and investors Alter Global, Lightspeed and Y Combinator. Y Combinator gives 2017 as the founding year; KrASIA reports work began in 2016 and the platform launched officially in 2017.

privy.note: Founded in October 2016 by Marshall Pribadi (CEO) and Guritno Adi Saputra (CTO), per Privy's own blog; KrASIA also names both, and Endeavor and Bisnis confirm Pribadi.

amartha.note: Founded in 2010 by Andi Taufan Garuda Putra, per Amartha.

broom.note: Founded in 2021 by Pandu Adi Laras and Andreas Sutanto, per Broom and TechCrunch. A 2022 youngster.id report also listed Pungky Wibawa as a co-founder, but Broom's own team page and later coverage name only the two.

swap-energi.note: Founded in 2019 by Irwan Tjahaja, per Indonesia Business Post and DealStreetAsia. Bisnis.com also describes Kevin Phang as a co-founder.

idn.note: Founded in 2014 by brothers Winston Utomo and William Utomo, per IDN and Katadata.

iseller.note: Founded in 2017 by Jimmy Petrus, per e27 and investor AppWorks. iSeller's own site says it was founded and built by Intersoft Solutions, a company Jimmy Petrus also founded.

evos-esports.note: Ivan Yeo is named as EVOS Esports' co-founder by Forbes and GGWP.id; GGWP.id dates the team to 1 September 2016.

eratani.note: Founded in 2021, per Eratani and TechCrunch. Andrew Soeherman is co-founder and CEO; Angles Gani is named as a co-founder by TechCrunch and on his own profile. TechCrunch also names Kevin Laksono as a co-founder.

rekosistem.note: Founded by Ernest Christian Layman and Joshua Valentino, per Forbes, Bisnis and investor East Ventures; Katadata says the founders started the venture in 2018.

beautyhaul.note: Founded by Irene Ursula and Benny Yahya, per BeautyHaul's careers site, which says BeautyHaul began as a beauty e-commerce site in 2014; Somethinc, its skincare brand, launched in 2019.

brick.note: Founded in early 2020 by Gavin Tan and Deepak Malhotra, per Hybrid and Katadata. Brick's Indonesian payment services now run through PT Eastern Transglobal Remittance, a licensed company established in 2011 that Brick acquired in 2023.

sweetescape.note: Founded in 2017 by David Soong and Emile Etienne, per TechCrunch, KrASIA and investor Burda Principal Investments.

soul-parking.note: Soul Parking's seed-funding announcement names five co-founders, and investor AppWorks confirms Kenneth Darmansjah and Unggul Depirianto. An article republished on the company's site dates the founding to 2019 and also names Bahagia Waluyo, who is not among the five co-founders the company lists.

fishlog.note: Founded by Bayu Anggara, Reza Fahlepi and Abdul Halim, per Antara, Bisnis and investor Accel.

jendela360.note: KrASIA reports that Jendela360 was founded in 2017 by Kiki Guzali, Daniel Rannu and Ade Indra; Kiki Guzali's co-founder role is also stated on his own profile.

anantarupa-studios.note: Ivan Chen founded Anantarupa Studios in 2011, per Hypeabis and the studio's milestones; COO Diana Paskarina's profile also names him as her co-founder.

sirka.note: Founded in 2021 by Rifanditto Adhikara and Dito Krista, per Liputan6 and e27.

dayatani.note: Founded in 2023 by Ankit Gupta and Deryl Lu, per DayaTani's official LinkedIn page and AgNavigator.

magalarva.note: Founded in 2017 by Rendria Labde with co-founder Arunee Sarasetsiri, per Magalarva's About page.

stafbook.note: Y Combinator lists Fransiskus Raymond and Ghuniyu Fattah Rozaq as StafBook's founders and gives 2021 as its founding year; Ghuniyu Fattah Rozaq's co-founder role is also stated on his own profile.

amtiss.note: Ivan F. Gautama is named as Amtiss's founder by Hybrid and e27; Liputan6 dates the company to 2015.

tomoro-coffee.note: Founded in 2022 by Xing Wei Yuan, also known as Star Yuan, per Fortune Indonesia, Vulcan Post and QSR Media. Vulcan Post also calls Fish Sun a co-founder; this is not yet confirmed by a second independent source.

bank-jago.note: Jerry Ng is named as Bank Jago's founder by Kompas and the World Bank. CNBC Indonesia also counts Arief Harris Tandjung among its founders.

hukumonline.note: Founded in 2000 by legal practitioners including Ahmad Fikri Assegaf, Arief T. Surowidjojo and Ibrahim Sjarief Assegaf, per Hukumonline; youngster.id also credits the Indonesian Center for Law and Policy Studies (PSHK) as a founding party.

myskill.note: Founded in mid-2021 by Angga Fauzan and Erahmat, per investor East Ventures, Antara and Bisnis.

koltiva.note: Koltiva lists Manfred Borer, Ainu Rofiq and Furqonuddin Ramdhani as co-founders and says it was founded in Indonesia in 2013. A 2018 company presentation says Manfred Borer founded Koltiva AG in Switzerland and joined PT Koltiva in 2017.

tirto-id.note: Founded in 2016 by Atmaji Sapto Anggoro, per FaktualNews; Hybrid also names him as Tirto.id's founder.

lister.note: Founded by Sigit Arifianto, per Lister; it began in 2019 as Listerclub, a non-profit offering free IELTS classes.

belajarlagi.note: Faiz Ghifari is named as Belajarlagi's founder by Antara and ITB's School of Business and Management.

catapa.note: Founded on 21 April 2017 by Stefanie Suanita, per CATAPA.

qwords.note: Founded in July 2005 by Rendy Maulana Akbar while he was a student at ITB, per Qwords.

avani-eco.note: Kevin Kumala is named as Avani Eco's co-founder by the company and as its founder by NBC News; Digination dates the founding to 2014.

prosa-ai.note: Founded in 2018 out of research by Ayu Purwarianti and Dessi Puji Lestari together with Teguh Eko Budiarto, per Hybrid and Bisnis.

kontrak-hukum.note: Rieke Caroline is named as founder and CEO by Kontrak Hukum and Warta Ekonomi.

awanio.note: Iskandar Soesman is named as Awanio's founder by youngster.id and on his own profile. Sources differ on the start date: CNBC Indonesia says Awanio has operated since 2016, while Tech in Asia, republished by investor Init-6, says the project began in 2018.

gokampus.note: Nathanael Santoso is named as goKampus's founder and CEO by Antara and Liputan6; Liputan6 says the platform first launched in 2018.

jangjo.note: Eki Setijadi is named as a co-founder by Liputan6 and on his own profile. VOI (2022) and Katadata (2024) have also described Nyoman Kwanhok and Joe Hansen, respectively, as co-founder and CEO.

own-games.note: Eldwin Viriya is named as co-founder and CEO by IDN Times and on his own profile; IDN Times says the Bandung studio was founded in 2013.

kopi-kenangan.note: Founded in 2017 by Edward Tirtanata, James Prananto and Cynthia Chaerunissa (also spelled Chaerunnisa). The company's leadership page now lists her as Director; Detik reports that the official site earlier listed her as Co-Founder and Chief Marketing Officer, and the Japanese outlet THE BRIDGE also names her as a co-founder.

hypefast.note: Achmad Alkatiri is named as Founder & CEO on the company's website.

tokopedia.note: Founded by William Tanuwijaya and Leontinus Alpha Edison, per the company's own story page, which dates the launch to 17 August 2009.

bibit.note: Founded by Wellson Lo, Sigit Kouwagam and Johny Susanto, per AC Ventures and Teknologi.id; CNBC Indonesia also names Sigit Kouwagam as a founder.

flip.note: Founded in 2015 in Depok by University of Indonesia alumni Rafi Putra Arriyan, Luqman Sungkar and Ginanjar Ibnu Solikhin, per the company's website.

bukuwarung.note: Founded in 2019 by Abhinay Peddisetty and Chinmay Chauhan, per lead investor East Ventures and KrASIA.

aruna.note: Founded in 2016 by Farid Naufal Aslam, Indraka Fadhlillah and Utari Octavianty, per the company's Series A press release.

hangry.note: Founded in 2019 by Abraham Viktor, Robin Tan and Andreas Resha, per SWA and KrASIA.

maka-motors.note: Founded in 2021 by former Gojek executives Raditya Wibowo and Arief Fadillah, per investor East Ventures and Kontan.

colearn.note: Abhay Saboo and Marc Irawan are named as CoLearn's founders by KrASIA and on their own profiles; Katadata says Marc Irawan and other founders started CoLearn in 2018.

pintarnya.note: Founded by Nelly Nurmalasari, Ghirish Pokardas and Henry Hendrawan, per the company's website. The platform launched in May 2022; no source gives a separate founding year.

staffinc.note: Founded in 2018 as Sampingan by Wisnu Nugrahadi, Dimas Pramudya Putra and Margana Mohamad, per Antara, SWA and investor Golden Gate Ventures; the company later renamed itself Staffinc.

delos.note: Founded in 2021 by Guntur Mallarangeng, Aris Noerhadi, Alexander Farthing and Bobby Indra Gunawan Wibisono, per Katadata and JPNN; the company's site names Aris Noerhadi and Alexander Farthing as co-founders. An earlier Liputan6 report lists only Guntur Mallarangeng, Bobby Indra Gunawan and Alexander Farthing.

lifepal.note: Founded in 2019 by Giacomo Ficari, Nicolo Robba, Benny Fajarai and Reza Muhammad, per TechCrunch and Alinea.

kitalulus.note: Stevien Jimmy is named as co-founder by Liputan6 and Investor Daily. Liputan6 also names Wei-Chuan Chew as a founder, which no second independent source confirms. Investor Daily dates the founding to October 2021; Stevien Jimmy's own profile says 2020.

pintek.note: Tommy Yuwono is named as co-founder on the company's website and by Katadata; the company's LinkedIn page gives 2018 as the founding year. Katadata also names Ioann Fainsilber as a co-founder, which no second independent source confirms.

advotics.note: Founded in 2016 by Boris Sanjaya, Hendi Chandi and Jeffry William Tani, per TechCrunch; lead investor East Ventures also names Hendi Chandi and Jeffry Tani as co-founders.

crewdible.note: Dhana Galindra is named as founder and CEO by Antara and TrenAsia; the company says it was founded in 2017.

bababos.note: Founded in the third quarter of 2022 by Fajar Adiwidodo, Sigit Aryo Tejo and Hendrik Panca, per SWA and Katadata.

jejakin.note: Founded in 2018 by Arfan Arlanda, Sudono Salim, Andreas Djingga and Haris Iskandar, per the company's funding announcement.

haus.note: Gufron Syarif is named as co-founder and CEO by Kompas, Katadata and Kumparan. Kompas reports that Haus! was founded in June 2018 by four people, but gives the other three by first name only, so they are not listed.

flik.note: Ahmad Gadi is named as co-founder and CEO by lead investor East Ventures and by Marketing-Interactive.

mamikos.note: Maria Regina Anggit Tut Pinilih is named as founder by Bisnis.com and as co-founder and CEO by Warta Ekonomi; the company says it was founded on 11 November 2015.

jutsoo.note: Mario Gaw and Kristian Frits Harris Sinaulan are listed as founders on Y Combinator's company page and on their own profiles. Jutsoo grew out of Bananas, a Y Combinator Winter 2022 startup; YC gives 2021 as the founding year, while one co-founder's profile dates Bananas to 2022.

pahamify.note: Founded in January 2018 by Syarif Rousyan Fikri, Mohammad Ikhsan and Edria Albert, per the company's About page.

revou.note: Founded in 2019 by Matteo Sutto, per the company's website and Hybrid.

indodax.note: Founded by Oscar Darmawan and William Sutanto as Bitcoin Indonesia, later renamed Indodax, per the company's newsroom and Fortune Indonesia. The company gives 2014 as its founding year; William Sutanto's own profile dates the original Bitcoin.co.id to 2013.

tanamera-coffee.note: Founded in 2013 by Dini Aryani Criddle, per the company's website.

komerce.note: Nofi Bayu Darmawan is named as founder and CEO by BackScoop and Uzone; Uzone reports that Komerce grew out of the Kampung Marketer social movement in Purbalingga.

boleh-dicoba.note: Rizki Fahrurrozi is named as founder and CEO by TopBusiness and Heaptalk; the company says it was founded in 2017.

kredit-pintar.note: Wisely Reinharda Wijaya is named as a founder by Bisnis.com, IDN Times and Digital News Asia; the company says it was founded in 2017. Kredit Pintar is now part of Atome Financial, owned by Singapore's Advance Intelligence Group.

purwadhika-digital-technology-school.note: Founded in 1987 by Purwa Hartono, per the company's website and SWA.

dash-electric.note: Founded in November 2023 by Aditya Brahmana and Robert Mulianto, per the company's newsroom.

trustmedis.note: Achmad Zulkarnain is presented as CEO and founder on the company's About page and on his own profile. The company says it was established in 2016, building on a healthcare IT business it began in 2011.

dewaweb.note: Edy Budiman is named as founder and CEO by Marketing.co.id and by BINUS University's alumni profile.

qasir.note: Rachmat Anggara is named as co-founder by Katadata and on his own profile; the company says it was founded in 2015. Novan Adrian describes himself as a co-founder on his own profile, which no second independent source confirms.

grivy.note: Jan B. Oudeman is named as Founder & CEO on the company's website and official LinkedIn page.

mtarget.note: Yopie Suryadi is named as founder and CEO on the company's blog, which says he founded MTARGET with a friend in 2016; youngster.id and Dunia Fintech name Masas Dani as a co-founder. Dunia Fintech also names Johan Tahardi, which no second qualifying source confirms.

orderonline.note: Founded in July 2018 by Rovan Alfarry and Fazlur Rahman, per DailySocial and Warta Ekonomi.

surplus-indonesia.note: Muhammad Agung Saputra is named as founder by Forbes and as co-founder and CEO by youngster.id. Forbes dates the app's launch to 2021; no source gives a separate founding year.

minapoli.note: Founded on 21 November 2017 by Rully Setya Purnama, per the company's About page.

dibimbing-id.note: Founded in 2020 by Zaky Muhammad Syah, Alim Anggono and Wildan Fahmi Gunawan, per Forbes.

trucarbon.note: Founded in December 2022 as TruClimate and renamed TruCarbon in 2024; Debby Reynata is named as co-founder and CEO by ANTARA and detikInet. ANTARA also names Jeffrey Dharmawan as a co-founder, which no second independent source confirms.

intura.note: Founded in 2025 by Najwa Assilmi and Muhammad Ramadiansyah, per the company's About page.

cakap.note: Started as the language-learning platform Squline and renamed Cakap in 2019. The company names Tomy Yunus and Yohan Limerta as founders and Cecilia Ong and Margarita Tan as co-founders. The company's blog dates Squline to 2014; Fortune Indonesia gives 2015.

kredivo.note: The company names Akshay Garg, Alie Tan and Umang Rustagi as co-founders. Its parent, FinAccel (now Kredivo Group), was incorporated in 2015, and Kredivo disbursed its first loan in April 2016.

pintu.note: Founded by Jeth Soetoyo, per the company's own site; Detik also names him as Pintu's founder.

pluang.note: Founded in 2019 by Claudia Kolonas and Richard Chua.

evermos.note: Founded in Bandung in November 2018. The company names Iqbal Muslimin, Ilham Taufiq and Arip Tirta among its founders; Forbes and other press also name Ghufron Mustaqim as a co-founder. A 2022 Forbes list profile instead names Iqbal Muslimin and Andika Saputra as co-founders.

julo.note: Founded in late 2016 by Adrianus Hitijahubessy, Hans Sebastian and Victor Darmadi.

alami-sharia.note: Founded by Dima Djani, Harza Sandityo and Bembi Juniar; the company launched in 2018, per its own press release.

brik.note: Founded in 2022. Investors Accel and Alter Global name Francis Anugrah as BRIK's founder. Warta Ekonomi also names three further co-founders, including Alan Budiarto and Ria Astika, but no independent second source confirms them.

bhinneka.note: Founded by Hendrik Tio. The company says it has operated since 1993; Inc42 gives 1995 as the founding year.

jala.note: The company's About page lists seven co-founders, including chairman Aryo Wiryawan and CEO Liris Maduningtyas.

komunal.note: Founded in Surabaya in 2018 by Hendry Lieviant, Kendrick Winoto and Rico Tedyono.

gowork.note: GoWork merged with the coworking operator Rework in 2018. Richard Lim and Donny Tandianus co-founded GoWork; Vanessa Hendriadi Li founded Rework and is a co-founder of the merged company.

mangkokku.note: Founded in 2019 by chef Arnold Poernomo with Randy Julius Kartadinata, Gibran Rakabuming and Kaesang Pangarep, per the company's About page.

esqa-cosmetics.note: Founded in 2016 by Cindy Angelina and Kezia Trihatmanto. Fortune Indonesia lists the second co-founder as Kezia Toemion.

asa-ren.note: The company names Aloysius Liang as its founder and CEO.

lifepack.note: Founded in 2019 by Natali Ardianto, per Universitas Indonesia's computer science faculty; Gizmologi also names him as Lifepack's co-founder. The service is run by PT Indopasifik Teknologi Medika Indonesia. Other co-founders are not confirmed.

visinema.note: Visinema began in 2008. Fortune Indonesia and youngster.id name Angga Dwimas Sasongko as its founder; any other co-founders are not yet confirmed by two independent sources.

fairatmos.note: Founded in 2022 by Natalia Rialucky Marsudi. The company's LinkedIn page also calls its chief commercial and operating officer, Aruna P., a co-founder, while investor Vertex Ventures lists Natalia Rialucky Marsudi as the sole founder.

zi-care.note: Jessy Abdurrahman is the founder and CEO. Investor Crusade Partners also lists Sanjaya I. Mayluddin and Jodi Pujiyono Susanto as co-founders.

tanamduit.note: The company lists Indra Suryawan, Rini Hapsari S and Ferry Aprilianto as its founders.

blitz-electric-mobility.note: The company's 2025 funding announcement names Saivya Chauhan as founder and CEO and William So as co-founder and CFO.

carbonethics.note: Founded in May 2019 by Agung Bimo Listyanu, Jessica Novia and Innandya Kusumawardhani, who met at the One Young World summit. Company and investor materials also list them as Bimo Soewadji and as Innandya Irawan or Innandya van der Kolk.

agate.note: Agate was formally established in 2009 by a large founding group (Digital News Asia counts 18 founders, IDN Times 15). Arief Widhiyasa, Shieny Aprilia and Aditia Dwi Perdana are confirmed as co-founders; the others are not listed.

whiz.note: Dominic Sumarli is named as a founder by Y Combinator and in his own posts. Y Combinator also lists Frederick Widjaja as a founder.

titipku.note: Co-founded by Henri Suhardja and Ong Tek Tjan.

idexpress.note: Francis Anugrah (also spelled Anugerah) is named as a co-founder by JPNN and Warta Ekonomi. Deputy CEO Charles Lim also describes himself as a co-founder.

kasir-pintar.note: The company lists Didit Sepiyanto, Burhanudin Rasyid, Sitti Raisya Fitri E. and Nuning Septiana as its founders. The app was first published in April 2016.

bumame.note: Founded in 2020; investor 500 Global names James Wihardja as co-founder and CEO.

kaskus.note: Kaskus was started in 1999 by Andrew Darwis and two fellow students in Seattle; Suara names them as Budi Dharmawan and Ronald Stephanus, which a second source has not confirmed.

kelas-pintar.note: Kelas Pintar was developed by PT Extramarks Education Indonesia; the press names Fernando Uffie as its founder and CEO.

cekat-ai.note: Co-founded by Matthew Sebastian and Nicholas Alden Liem, per investor Insignia Ventures and the founders' own profiles.

tokocrypto.note: Founded in June 2018; the company names Pang Xue Kai as its co-founder and CEO.

rimba-makmur-utama.note: PT Rimba Makmur Utama, which runs the Katingan Mentaya Project, was founded in 2007 by Rezal Kusumaatmadja and Dharsono Hartono, per the project's own site.

imajin.note: Founded by Chendy Jaya, Stefanus Hodir and Joseline Olivia, per the company and investor East Ventures. SWA dates the start, as a 3D marketplace and community, to 2014.

sonar-platform.note: Founded in 2015 by Amien Krisna and M. Ridwan Agustiawan, per the company's About page.

mileapp.note: MileApp, later separated from Paket.id, says it was founded in 2015; its 2020 press release names Dika Maheswara as CEO and founder.

nodeflux.note: Founded in January 2016 by Meidy Fitranto and Faris Rahman.

dattabot.note: Dattabot, previously known as Mediatrac, names Regi Wahyu as founder and CEO and Imron Zuhri as co-founder and CTO. Its LinkedIn page gives 2003 as the founding year.

healthpro.note: Co-founded by Rendy Alfuadi and Vika Rachma Sari during the COVID-19 pandemic.

otospector.note: Founded in 2016, per the company; Jeffrey Andika is named as its founder and CEO.

carbonx.note: Pandu Sjahrir is named as co-founder and president commissioner by the company and Antara; other co-founders have not been confirmed.

dycode.note: Andri Yadi is named as DyCode's founder and CEO; CHIP notes that other early founders later left the company.

jt-auto.note: Titos Jatiarso is named as a co-founder of Javatech Automation (JT Auto); other co-founders are not named. Its LinkedIn page gives 2013 as the founding year.

traveloka.note: Founded in 2012 by Ferry Unardi, Derianto Kusuma and Albert Zhang. Some reports, such as Kontan, give Albert's first name only; Detik and Okezone give his full name. Derianto Kusuma stepped down as CTO in 2018.

tiket-com.note: Founded in August 2011 by Gaery Undarsa, Wenas Agusetiawan, Dimas Surya Yaputra and Natali Ardianto, per The Jakarta Post and Bisnis. Fortune Indonesia says Gaery Undarsa started it with five friends, which suggests a larger original group, but no other founders are named.

dekoruma.note: Founded in 2015 by Dimas Harry Priawan and Aruna Harsa, per the company.

astro.note: Vincent Tjendra, Jessica Stephanie Jap and Marcella Moniaga are named as co-founders by Endeavor and by investor Lightspeed, DealStreetAsia or TechCrunch; Lightspeed dates the company to 2021. DealStreetAsia also names a fourth co-founder, Sherlyn G., but gives no full surname, so she is not listed.

pinhome.note: Founded by Dayu Dara Permata and Ahmed Aljunied. The company gives 2020 as its founding year; SWA reports it was set up in late 2019 and began operating in early 2020.

rans-entertainment.note: Raffi Ahmad is named as the founder and dates RANS to 2016. Antara describes the company as owned by Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who serves as President Director.

wagely.note: Founded in 2020 by Tobias Fischer and Sasanadi Ruka, per the company's press release.

gokomodo.note: Founded in 2019 by Samuel Tirtasaputra and William Pramana, per the company.

green-rebel-foods.note: Founded in 2020 by Helga Angelina Tjahjadi and Max Mandias, who also own the Burgreens restaurant chain.

rukita.note: Rukita and investor MPower Partners credit sisters Sabrina and Sarah Soewatdy as the co-founders. Golden Gate Ventures also lists Xu-Zonne Ho, and Peak XV lists Xu-Zonne Ho, Wei-Chuan Chew and YC Ng, as co-founders.

nalagenetics.note: Nalagenetics, a spin-off of A*STAR's Genome Institute of Singapore, lists Levana Sani, Astrid Irwanto, Alexander Lezhava and Jianjun Liu as its founders.

reku.note: Reku, established in 2018, names Sumardi Fung and Robby as founders. It also names a third founder, Johny, without giving his surname.

beleaf-farms.note: Founded in 2019 by Amrit Lakhiani, per lead investor Alpha JWC Ventures.

durianpay.note: Founded in Jakarta in September 2020 by Antara Sara Mathai, Kumar Puspesh and Natasha Ardiani, per Antara and Hybrid.

kitabisa.note: Founded in 2013 by Alfatih Timur and Vikra Ijas (spelled Vikra Ijaz on Kitabisa's blog). Bisnis also describes Rhenald Kasali, Alfatih Timur's mentor, as a co-founder.

diri-care.note: Diri Care's site names Deviana Himawan, its Chief Clinical Officer, as a co-founder; the rest of the founding team is not confirmed.

sekilo.note: Sekilo, formerly the quick-commerce startup Dropezy, pivoted to poultry supply in January 2023. Y Combinator lists Chandni Chainani and Nitish Chellaram as co-founders and 2019 as the founding year.

dataon.note: Founded by Gordon Enns, per the company.

qiscus.note: Qiscus, established in 2013, lists Delta Purna Widyangga, Muhammad Md Rahim and Evan Purnama as its founders; a 2015 Liputan6 report on the founding team also includes Amin Nordin.

female-daily-network.note: Female Daily described Hanifa Ambadar (Hanzky) and Affi Assegaf as its two founders in 2012. The Jakarta Post also counts Novita Imelda, who joined in 2011 as an investor and operating director, among the founders.

dealls.note: Founded in 2020 by Andhika Sudarman, per Y Combinator.

cermati.note: Founded by Andhy Koesnandar, Oby Sumampouw and Carlo Gandasubrata. Cermati launched in April 2015; Oby Sumampouw dates the founding of the group to December 2014.

erigo.note: Founded in 2011 by Muhammad Sadad, originally under the name Selected & Co., per the company.

katadata.note: Katadata, founded on 1 April 2012, names Metta Dharmasaputra and Ade Wahyudi as co-founders.

nuanu.note: Founded in 2020 by Sergey Solonin; construction of the Bali site began in October 2020.

otten-coffee.note: Founded by Robin Boe and Jhoni Kusno. Otten Coffee started as an offline business in Medan in 2012 and moved into e-commerce in 2014.

global-urban-esensial.note: Founded by Tiffany Robyn Soetikno, who co-founded GoApotik, the company's first service; any other co-founders are not named.

infia.note: INFIA was founded in 2014; the company names Aji Pratomo as founder and Andrey Noelfry Tarigan and Muhammad Noviar Rahman as co-founders.

mobee.note: Founded by Andrew Tjahyadikarta and Jeff Pradana, per the company, which gives October 2021 as its founding date; Blockhead dates the start to 2022.

toge-productions.note: Founded in 2009 by Kris Antoni (Kris Antoni Hadiputra), who started making games with a friend, per the company.

bukit-vista.note: Co-founded by Jing Cho Yang and Wayana Yang, per the company; Jing's profile also credits early team member Bayu. The company traces Bukit Vista to a 2009 side project and dates its formal founding to 2013-2014.

codemi.note: Founded by Zaki Falimbany, who started building Codemi in 2014.

plasticpay.note: Founded by Suhendra Setiadi, who is also its CEO.

duitin.note: Duitin's site lists Astriani Liewaputra, Agdya Savanto, Adijoyo Prakoso and Rangga Dwiyandra as its founders.

voltron.note: Founded by Abdul Rahman Elly; the charging network was called EVCuzz until it was renamed Voltron in May 2023.

kepul.note: Founded by Abdul Latif Wahid Nasution (listed by the company as Abdul Latif), who is also its CEO.

nightspade.note: Nightspade, founded in 2010, lists CEO Gerry (Garibaldy Wibowo Mukti) and CFO Teddy (Teddy Pandu) as co-founders. A Teknojurnal profile names Inas Luthfi and Dody Dharma as the other two of four original founders.

blibli.note: Blibli's leadership page names Kusumo Martanto (CEO), Lisa Widodo (COO) and Hendry (CCO) as co-founders; founded in 2011, per the company. Some press profiles also list Martin Hartono and Lay Ridwan Gautama among five founders, but the company's own pages do not, so they are not listed here.

bukalapak.note: Founded in 2010 by Achmad Zaky, Muhamad Fajrin Rasyid and Nugroho Herucahyono, per the company's announcement and Kompas.

halodoc.note: Jonathan Sudharta is named co-founder and CEO on his own profile and by McKinsey; Liputan6 and SWA name Doddy Lukito, the Chief Business Officer, as a co-founder. Halodoc dates its start to 2016.

sayurbox.note: Founded in 2016 by Amanda Susanti (also known as Amanda Cole), Rama Notowidigdo and Metha Trisnawati, per investor Insignia Ventures and press reports; KrASIA dates the start to 2016 and the app first launched in July 2016.

honest.note: Peter Panas and Will Ongkowidjaja are named as co-founders on the company's About page and in its 2025 funding announcement. Honest launched its credit card business in 2023; no founding year is stated.

mekari.note: Mekari grew out of Sleekr, which Suwandi Soh and Dirman Suharno set up in 2015, per Mekari's About page; Sleekr merged with Jurnal and Talenta in 2018 to form Mekari. Jurnal was co-founded by Anthony Kosasih and Daniel Witono.

paxel.note: Founded in 2017 by a group of logistics veterans including Bryant Christanto, Johari Zein and Zaldy Ilham Masita, per Digination; Endeavor, CNBC Indonesia and the company each confirm one of them as a co-founder. Paxel launched officially in early 2018.

ayoconnect.note: Founded in 2016 by Jakob Rost, Chiragh Kirpalani and Adi Vora, per KrASIA; the company names Jakob Rost as founder and CEO.

lemonilo.note: In a 2018 interview the company said Shinta Nurfauzia, Ronald Wijaya and Johannes Ardiant founded Lemonilo in 2016; the three are presented as its leadership on the company's website.

bobobox.note: Founded in Bandung by Indra Gunawan and Antonius Bong. The company and investor Genesis Ventures give 2018 as the founding year; one Bisnis report says 2017.

majoo.note: Founded by Adi Wahyu Rahadi, Audia Rizal Harahap and Bayu Indriarko, per the company. The company says majoo was initiated in 2018 and began commercial service in July 2019.

chickin.note: Founded in 2020 by Ashab Alkahfi, Tubagus Syailendra Wangsadisastra and Ahmad Syaifullah, per investor East Ventures and Katadata.

skorlife.note: Ongki Kurniawan and Karan Khetan are named as co-founders on the company's About page and by TechCrunch.

ringkas.note: Ilya Kravtsov, Leroy Pinto and Yoko Simon are named as co-founders on the company's About page. A 2025 press report also lists Puguh Widyoko as a co-founder; he is not named on the company's About page.

baskit.note: Yann Schuermans, Yoonjung Yi and Abhishek Pansari are named as co-founders by the company and investor Cento Ventures. TechCrunch reported in June 2023 that Baskit was founded the previous year; Cento Ventures gives 2023.

saturdays.note: Founded by Rama Suparta and Andrew Kandolha, who met in 2015, per InfoBrand; investor DSG Consumer Partners also names Andrew Kandolha as co-founder.

waste4change.note: Mohamad Bijaksana Junerosano is named founder by the company; other co-founders are not named. Waste4Change marked its fourth anniversary in December 2018, consistent with a 2014 start.

elevarm.note: Bayu Syerli is named co-founder and CEO by the company; Forbes lists Febi Agil Ifdillah and Lintang Kusuma Pratiwi as co-founders. Forbes reported in 2023 that Elevarm launched the previous year.

materee.note: Hansel Hansel and Steven Walentino are named as co-founders by investors Y Combinator and Wayfinder Ventures; founded in 2022.

semaai.note: Founded in 2021 by Muhammad Yoga Anindito, Gaurav Batra and Abhishek Gupta (also spelled Abishek in some reports).

gently.note: Founded by Nyoman Anjani and Ramadhan Satrio Nugroho. Investor Init-6 gives 2021 as the founding year; an ITB faculty article says 2022.

proglix.note: Founded in 2022 by Wynn Wijaya, Wendy Wijaya and Prawira Indrawan, per investor Y Combinator; e27 gives the CEO's and CTO's names as Wynn Nathaniel and Prawira Indra.

runchise.note: Daniel Witono and Ivana Widjaja are named as co-founders on the company's About page; founded in 2022.

karyakarsa.note: Founded by Ario Tamat, the late Aria Rajasa and Pribadi Prananta, per the company's help centre.

arkopay.note: Laura Lukito is named as a co-founder on the company's website; other co-founders could not be confirmed.

j-t-express.note: J&T Global Express names Jet Jie Li (also known as Jet Lee) as its founder; he set up the J&T brand in Indonesia in June 2015. Some Indonesian press reports also name Tony Chen as a co-founder, which the company's own profile does not.

common-grounds.note: The company says it was founded by four friends in 2014. MTPak Coffee names them as Yoshua Tanu, Aston Utan, Daryanto Witarsa and Philip Chen, and Sprudge reported in 2014 that the four partners had opened the first café that March.

botika.note: Ditto Anindita and Galuh Koco Sadewo are named as founders on the company's blog; other co-founders could not be confirmed.

lamudi-indonesia.note: Lamudi Indonesia's own site names Antonius Salis as co-founder and managing director. Kian Moini and Paul Philipp Hermann co-founded the international Lamudi group and are not counted as founders of the Indonesian company.

ekrut.note: The company names Steven Suliawan and Ardo Gozal as its founders and dates its start to September 2016. Investor Venturra and an early funding report also list Anthony Kusuma as a co-founder; the company's own account does not.

riliv.note: Founded by brothers Audrey Maximillian Herli and Audy Christopher Herli; the app launched on 6 August 2015.

ledgerowl.note: Investors Skystar Capital and Incubate Fund name Rey Kamal and Adrian Yasin as founders. An Incubate Fund announcement also counts Oscar Syarif among the founders, which its portfolio page does not.

educa-studio.note: Founded by husband and wife Andi Taru Nugroho Nur Wismoyo and Idawati; the company marked its 12th anniversary in April 2023.

muatmuat.note: Daniel Setiawan is named founder and CEO in coverage of the app's official launch in Surabaya in February 2024; the company's LinkedIn page gives 2020 as the founding year.

habibi-garden.note: Dian Prayogi Susanto is named as Habibi Garden's founder in several news reports; other co-founders could not be confirmed.

xeratic.note: Feris Thia is named founder, CEO and CTO on the company's About page; the company was previously known as PHI Integration. Other co-founders could not be confirmed.

algobash.note: Founded in 2021 by Elfino Sitompul and Melinda Wardiman, per investor Init-6.

nusaqu.note: Nanang Sugiarto is named founder and CEO by the company and by RRI.

qalboo.note: Windy Dhaliana is named CEO and co-founder by Antara and on her own profile; founded in 2022. Other co-founders could not be confirmed.

akulaku.note: Founded by William Li and Gordon Hu, per CNBC Indonesia and Okezone. Akulaku gives 2016 as its founding year; both reports say the two started the business in 2014, initially as a bitcoin app for foreign workers in Hong Kong.

ruangguru.note: Founded in 2014 by Adamas Belva Syah Devara and Iman Usman, per Ruangguru's own announcement.

charged-asia.note: Joel Chang is named as Charged's co-founder by The Straits Times and Vulcan Post. Charged Asia, headquartered in Singapore with production in Indonesia, was founded in March 2022. Other co-founders could not be confirmed.

modalku.note: Co-founded by Kelvin Teo and Reynold Wijaya, per Modalku's own blog and investor Triodos. Their group, Funding Societies, was founded in 2015; Modalku is its Indonesian platform.

moladin.note: Moladin's own press release names Andrew Khoo (co-founder and CEO) and Jovin Hoon (co-founder and COO) and says the company was founded in 2017. Kumparan also reports that Jovin Hoon started Moladin with Mario Tanamas, who later left; no second source confirms this.

super.note: CNBC Indonesia and Kontan name Steven Wongsoredjo (CEO) and Debeasinta Budiman as co-founders, and TechCrunch also confirms Wongsoredjo. Founded in 2018. Investor Y Combinator also lists Michael Rendy Tanuwidjaja as a founder; no second independent source confirms this yet.

pasarpolis.note: Founded in 2015 by Cleosent Randing, per Rest of World and investor Genesis Ventures; PasarPolis dates its founding to 2015.

agriaku.note: Founded in May 2021 by Irvan Kolonas and Danny Handoko, per investor Alpha JWC and youngster.id. AgFunderNews also calls Rezky Haryanto Agustia a co-founder, but other coverage names only Kolonas and Handoko as founders, so he is not listed.

esb.note: ESB says it was founded in 2018 by Gunawan Woen and his co-founders. IndoTelko lists Gunawan Woen, Eka Prasetya, Setiadi Prawiryo Moeljadi and Dwi Prawira as founders and dates the company to 2014; Eka Prasetya and Dwi Prawira are not yet confirmed by a second source.

ralali.note: Founded by Joseph Aditya with co-founder and CTO Irwan Suryady, per Ralali's own news site. Joseph Aditya says he started Ralali.com as a website in August 2013 and incorporated it in July 2014.

travelio.note: Founded in 2015 by Hendry Rusli, Christina Suriadjaja and Christie Tjong, per Travelio's own press release, Investor Daily and Teknologi.id.

jago-coffee.note: Co-founded by Yoshua Tanu and Christopher Oentojo; the company names Daniel Sidik as a co-founder who joined in 2022. All three are Endeavor Entrepreneurs. Antara reports Jago began operating in 2020 after a 2019 prototype.

fithub.note: FIT HUB launched in August 2020. Endeavor Indonesia and investor Wavemaker Partners name CEO William Tjajadi as a founder; other co-founders are not confirmed by two independent sources.

nusatrip.note: Hans Ebenhahn is named NusaTrip's founder by The Jakarta Post, TTG Asia and Web in Travel. NusaTrip gives 2015 as its founding year; TTG Asia reported in April 2013 that the NusaTrip.com booking site had launched the month before.

paper-id.note: Co-founded by Yosia Sugialam (CEO) and Jeremy Limman (CPO), per Paper.id's About page.

pintar.note: Novistiar Rustandi co-founded HarukaEdu (now Pintar) in February 2013 with three friends, per Kontan; the other co-founders are not confirmed by two independent sources.

klinik-pintar.note: Investor Altara Ventures and Infobank name CEO Harya Bimo as a co-founder. Altara also lists Eko S. Nugroho as a co-founder, which no second independent source confirms. Altara dates the founding to 2018; KrASIA says Klinik Pintar launched in 2019.

rey.note: Founded in 2021 by Evan Tanotogono and Bobby Siagian, per TechCrunch and Republika.

idcloudhost.note: IDCloudHost's blog names Muhammad Mufid Luthfi as a co-founder; other co-founders are not confirmed by two independent sources.

juragan-material.note: Co-founded in 2021 by Tito Putra (CEO), Graceila Putri, Ricky Fernando and Meichael Surja, per The Business Times and TechCrunch.

kata-ai.note: Investor 500 Global names Irzan Raditya as founder and says the company was founded in 2015 as YesBoss. Other co-founders are not confirmed by two independent sources.

finku.note: Co-founded by Shyam Kalairajah, Reinaldo Tendean and Shylla Estee Pramadhani, per Hybrid.co.id and Reinaldo Tendean's own post.

monit.note: Rizki Aditya is named co-founder by DailySocial and founder and CEO on his own profile.

spun.note: Founded in 2024 by Christa Sabathaly (CEO) and Dilla Anindita (CPO), per SPUN's blog and Antara.

grouu.note: Founded in 2020 by Natalia Imelda, Jessica Marthin and Ratna Pratama, per Campaign Indonesia; Ratna Pratama is not yet confirmed by a second independent source.

jack.note: DailySocial names Edo Windratno co-founder and CEO of Jack and Transfez, and investor Y Combinator lists him as a founder. Y Combinator also lists CTO Bondan Herumurti as a founder and gives 2020 as the founding year.

arkademi.note: Hilman Fajrian is named co-founder by CompassList and founder on his own profile. CompassList also names Resi Dwi Erveny as a co-founder, not yet confirmed by a second independent source.

jiwa-group.note: Founded by Billy Kurniawan, per Jiwa Group and Tempo. Tempo reports Kopi Janji Jiwa first launched in mid-2018.

bimasakti.note: Founded by Ibnu Sunanto. The company dates itself to 2004, when it started as PT Bimasakti Multiwealth; SWA gives 2009 for the current PT Bimasakti Multi Sinergi.

harisenin-com.note: Founded in late 2020 by Mirza Saputra, Kezia Manege and Muhammad Irfan, per Teknologi.id and Marketing.co.id. Marketing.co.id also counts CMO Dyo Fathu Rahman among four people who started it; other coverage names three founders.

narasi.note: Founded by Najwa Shihab around February 2018, per Kumparan and Hybrid.co.id; some profiles date the company to 2017. Other co-founders are not confirmed by two independent sources.

jubelio.note: Jubelio's CEO, Susandi Putra Nasution, is named as a founder by the company's own blog and by DailySocial. DailySocial lists Luthfi Makhfudz and Arif Budiman as the other two co-founders, while Kontan has described Andra Yusuf as a co-founder; those names are not listed until sources agree.

timedoor.note: Founded in 2014 in Bali by Yutaka Tokunaga, per the company's About page, where his CEO message describes starting the business.

torch.note: Founded in 2015 by Ben Wirawan and Hanafi Salman, per Bisnis Indonesia and Info Brand.

hijup.note: Founded in 2011 by Diajeng Lestari, per CNBC Indonesia and CNN Indonesia.

duitku.note: Rheza Gunawan Budiono is named co-founder and CEO by Hybrid.co.id and on his own profile; other co-founders are not confirmed by two independent sources.

loluna.note: Founded by Bianca Belnadia, Faldo Arsanda and Gary Nelson, per detikInet and their own profiles (and Forbes for Arsanda). The brand launched in September 2023.

biteship.note: Co-founded by Mirsa Sadikin (CEO) and Afra Sausan, per Biteship and investor East Ventures.

lahan-sikam.note: Lahan Sikam's website names Firmansyah as its founder; the company was established on 17 February 2018.

doogether.note: Co-founded in 2016 by Fauzan Gani and Helmy Rianda, per investor Asiantrust Capital; DailySocial also names Gani as co-founder.

alner.note: Alner's impact report names Bintang Ekananda as co-founder and CEO. The business began in 2020 under the Koinpack brand name before rebranding as Alner.

dana.note: Vincent Iswara (also written Vince Iswara) is named DANA's CEO and co-founder by Antara, Kontan and CNN Indonesia. Other co-founders could not be confirmed. DANA was set up in 2018, per IDX Channel.

sociolla.note: Founded in 2015 by Christopher Madiam, John Marco Rasjid and Chrisanti Indiana, per BeautyMatter and Katadata; Liputan6 and CNBC also name Madiam and Indiana as co-founders.

wahyoo.note: Founded in 2017 by Peter Shearer, per DailySocial's Hybrid.co.id and his own profile; TechCrunch gives the same year.

sicepat-ekspres.note: Founded in 2014 by The Kim Hai and Rudy Darwin Swigo, per Warta Ekonomi and iNews. TechCrunch describes The Kim Hai as founder and CEO of parent company Onstar Express.

gudangada.note: Founded in 2019 by Henry Stevensang (also known as Stevensang), per the company's About page; SWA also names him as founder. A KrASIA profile dates the start to 2018.

xurya.note: Founded in 2018 by Eka Himawan, Edwin Widjonarko and Philip Effendy, per investor East Ventures and youngster.id. East Ventures adds that the first two began the venture in 2017 and Philip Effendy joined later.

fuse.note: Founded by Andy Yeung and Ivan Sunandar, per Bisnis and DailySocial. DailySocial says Yeung started Fuse in 2016 and Sunandar became co-founder in 2018, when Fuse joined with Cekpremi.

alodokter.note: Founded in 2014 by Nathanael Faibis and Suci Arumsari, per the company's About page and its own press release.

segari.note: Yosua Setiawan and Farandy Ramadhana are named co-founders by DailySocial's Hybrid.co.id and their own profiles; Bisnis also names Ramadhana. The company says it was founded in 2020. A third co-founder named by DailySocial is not yet confirmed elsewhere.

doku.note: DOKU's own announcement names Himelda Renuat as a co-founder; IDN Times and her own profile name Nabilah Alsagoff as a founder. Renuat's profile says she founded DOKU with two others in 2007.

dailyco.note: Founded by Kelvin Subowo, per the company's About page and investor Vertex Ventures; the company dates its start to 2018.

dagangan.note: Founded in 2019 by Ryan Manafe and Wilson Yanaprasetya, per investor Monk's Hill Ventures; IDX Channel and Suara also name both as co-founders. Investor 500 Global refers to five co-founders; the other three are not confirmed by two independent sources.

transtrack.note: Founded in 2019 by Anggia Meisesari, per the company's own site; investor AppWorks and his own profile name Aris Pujud Kurniawan as co-founder.

populix.note: Founded in January 2018 by Timothy Astandu and Eileen Kamtawijoyo, per KrASIA. Jonathan Benhi, who joined as CTO in 2019, is also described as a co-founder in later coverage and on his own profile.

touchten-games.note: Anton Soeharyo is named founder by CNN Indonesia and The Bridge, which dates Touchten to 2009. In a Duniaku interview he described Touchten as having three founders, all relatives; the other two are not yet confirmed by a second source.

fresh-factory.note: Co-founded by Larry Ridwan, Widijastoro Nugroho and Andre Septiano, per Fortune Indonesia and DealStreetAsia; Y Combinator lists the founding year as 2020.

fundtastic.note: Harry Hartono, Franky Chandra and Medwin Susilo are named founders by TechCrunch and DailySocial; DailySocial also lists Eri Primaria among four founders. DailySocial says the company was founded in 2016 and launched its platform in 2019; TechCrunch gives 2019.

upbanx.note: Co-founded by Wafa Taftazani, Alif Jafar Fatkhurrohman and Hendri Wijaya, per Forbes and DailySocial; Y Combinator lists the founding year as 2021.

danacita.note: Danacita's own blog names Ketty Lie as its co-founder. Danacita belongs to ErudiFi, whose co-founders also include Riche Lim.

pina.note: Founded in 2021 by Daniel van Leeuwen with co-founders Fajar Kuntoro, Christian Hermawan and Hendry Chou, per TechCrunch and investors Y Combinator and 1982 Ventures.

verihubs.note: Founded in 2019 by Rick Firnando and Williem (listed by investor Insignia Ventures as Williem Williem), per Insignia Ventures and DailySocial.

pasarmikro.note: Co-founded by Dien Wong (CEO), Demetrius Edo Djayaputra and Hugo Verwayen, per e27, DailySocial and investors 1982 Ventures and DEG. PasarMIKRO launched in 2020, piloting its service in December that year.

matchmade.note: Tedo Esmu Ziraga and Gilang Gibranthama are named co-founders by DailySocial, which said in October 2023 that MatchMade was founded that year; e27 and their own profiles agree. A third co-founder named by DailySocial is not yet confirmed elsewhere.

pawoon.note: Founded in 2014 by Ahmad Gadi, per the company's own site and Inc42.

greenhope.note: Tommy Tjiptadjaja is named co-founder by SWA, BCG and his own profile; SWA says the company was founded in 2016. A second co-founder named by SWA is not yet confirmed elsewhere.

social-bread.note: Founded in 2020; the company's team page lists Edho Zell, Tirza Lydia and Ester Jeanette as co-founders. Investor East Ventures and press coverage name the COO as Lydia Susanti.

kumparan.note: kumparan names Hugo Diba, Ine Yordenaya and Arifin Asydhad as its founders and dates its launch to 17 January 2017. Early coverage in Digital News Asia also credited Detik.com founders Budiono Darsono, Abdul Rahman and Calvin Lukmantara with setting it up.

kopi-tuku.note: Andanu Prasetyo founded Toko Kopi Tuku and its parent PT Makna Angan Karya Andanu (MAKA), per Detik, Bisnis and Fortune Indonesia.

binar.note: Founded in 2017 by Alamanda Shantika, Dita Aisyah and Seto Lareno, per Forbes and DailySocial. Gilang Gibranthama's own profile also says he co-founded Binar Academy; other sources name only the three.

uss-networks.note: Founded in 2019 by Sayed Muhammad and Jeffry Jouw, per DealStreetAsia partner content and Jouw's own profile; the company's own site and IDN Times name Sayed Muhammad as founder. One USS Feed article also labels Anton Wirjono as founder and CEO of USS Networks, which no other source supports.

brodo.note: Muhammad Yukka Harlanda is named founder by Katadata and kumparan. kumparan also credits a second co-founder, not yet confirmed by another source.

vokraf.note: Fina Silmi Febriyani is named co-founder by her own profile and PETISI.CO. Two other executives describe themselves as co-founders on their own profiles; this is not yet confirmed by a second source.

nusantics.note: Founded in 2019 by Sharlini Eriza Putri, Vincent Kurniawan and Revata Utama, per investor East Ventures, Katadata and Fortune Indonesia. The company's About page gives 2020, and its site now describes Revata Utama as the sole remaining co-founder.

lenna-ai.note: Founded in 2017 by Alen Boby (also written Alen Bobby Hartanto), per the company's own site and LinkedIn page.

ravelware-technology.note: Founded in 2016 by Randy Budi Wicaksono, per Institut Teknologi Bandung's news site and Ipol.id. Other executives describe themselves as co-founders on their own profiles; this is not yet confirmed by a second source.

digital-happiness.note: Rachmad Imron is named founder by Katadata and his own profile. DailySocial and the studio's LinkedIn page date Digital Happiness to 2013; his profile dates his founder role to 2011.

gamechanger-studio.note: Founded in 2013 by Riris Marpaung and Dodick Sudirman, per the studio's own site. SWA describes Riris Marpaung building the studio in BSD City in 2018.

rebricks.note: Co-founded by Ovy Sabrina and Novita Tan, per the company's own site, which dates the start to June 2017; DW also names Novita Tan as a founder.

xendit.note: Founded in 2015 by Moses Lo, Tessa Wijaya, Juan Gonzalez and Bo Chen, per SWA and IDN Times; the company's own site also dates the founding to 2015.

fore-coffee.note: Fore Coffee opened its first store in August 2018. Investor East Ventures and Metro TV name Robin Boe and Jhoni Kusno, the co-founders of Otten Coffee, as its co-founders. The company and Metro TV also name Vico Lomar as a co-founder; he joined as CEO in 2020. Forbes profiles Elisa Suteja as a co-founder, but the company and East Ventures say she joined as CEO a year after launch, so she is not listed.

topindoku.note: Founded by Seiko Manito, per the company's site, his own site and Investortrust. The company's site gives 2018 as the founding year; his personal site says early 2019.

waresix.note: Co-founded in September 2017 by Andree Susanto and Edwin Wibowo, per East Ventures and AsiaTechDaily. East Ventures also lists a third co-founder, the CTO, by first name only (Filbert).

sirclo.note: Founded in 2013 by Brian Marshal, per the company's Board of Directors page.

koinworks.note: Founded in 2016 by Benedicto Haryono and Willy Arifin, per Katadata; KrASIA, Bisnis and a KoinWorks announcement also name both as co-founders.

flash-coffee.note: Co-founded by David Brunier and Sebastian Hannecker, per the company's 2021 funding announcement and Vulcan Post. The company says it was founded in Indonesia in 2019, and its first outlet opened in Jakarta.

vida.note: Founded in 2018 by Niki Luhur, Sati Rasuanto and Gajendran Kandasamy, per VIDA's own press release, Katadata and Suara.

kargo-technologies.note: Founded in November 2018 by Tiger Fang and Yodi Aditya, per the company's About page.

oy-indonesia.note: OY!'s own blog lists Jesayas Ferdinandus and Jan Kristanto as its founders; the company says it has operated since 2017.

praktis.note: Co-founded by Adrian Gilrandy, per East Ventures and his own profile. East Ventures' announcement also names Dipta Imanto and Mohamad Fahrul as co-founders.

legit-group.note: Co-founded in February 2021 by Sumarno Ngadiman, Monica Evanti Andriani and chairman Asrul Abraham Hendrata, per Hybrid.co.id and Digital News Asia; Antara also names Monica Evanti Andriani as a co-founder.

snapcart.note: Snapcart's own site names Reynazran Royono as founder and CEO and refers to three founders. In 2015 e27 also identified Laith Abu Rakty as CTO and co-founder.

otoklix.note: Founded in 2019 in Jakarta by Martin Reyhan Suryohusodo, Joseph Alexander Ananto and Benny Sutedjo, per the company's About page.

credibook.note: Co-founded in 2020 by Gabriel Frans, Dekha Anggareska and Christian Lie, per Y Combinator and Insignia Ventures.

akseleran.note: Mikhail Tambunan co-founded Akseleran, per Techsauce and his own profile. Techsauce reports three founders: Ivan Tambunan, Mikail (Mikhail) Tambunan and Christopher Gultom.

logisly.note: Founded in 2019 by Roolin Njotosetiadi and Robbi Baskoro, per KrASIA.

stickearn.note: Founded in 2017 by Archie Carlson, Garry Limanata, Hartanto Alim and Sugito Alim, per the company. Some coverage spells Garry Limanata as Garry Limananta.

kecilin.note: Founded by Christopher Farrel Millenio Kusumo, who has developed Kecilin since 2018, per Republika and Katadata.

hacktiv8.note: Founded in 2016 by Ronald Ishak and Riza Fahmi, per Hacktiv8's own sites.

broilerx.note: Prastyo Ruandhito is named as a co-founder by Insignia Ventures and on his own profile; Insignia also lists Jati Pikukuh and Pramudya Rizki Ruandhito. BroilerX dates its establishment to November 2020, while Insignia gives 2022.

finfra.note: Co-founded by Markus Prommik and Reinis Simanovskis, per the company's About page; founded in 2022, per AIN.

delman.note: Founded in 2018 by Surya Halim, Raymond Christopher and Theo Budiyanto, per the company's About page and TechCrunch.

gapai.note: Gapai's site presents a founding team of five co-founders: Radityo Susilo, Adji Pramono, Faizal Ramanda, Arsyanda Marsa and Rizky Primanda. The company was established on 25 May 2022 as PT Akademi Indonesia Cerdas under the Academix brand.

latent-space.note: Y Combinator lists Faza Fahleraz, Gery Nugraha and Albert Sahala as founders; Faza Fahleraz and Gery Nugraha also say so on their own profiles. Founded in 2022, per Y Combinator. Halo AI is one of Latent Space's products.

idrx.note: Nathanael Christian is IDRX's co-founder and CEO, per Investor Daily (investor.id), coverage quoting Antara, and his own profile.

stockbit.note: IDX Channel names Wellson Lo, Sigit Kouwagam and Johny Susanto as the three founders behind Stockbit; Wellson Lo and Johny Susanto also describe themselves as co-founders on their own profiles.

sevima.note: Founded in 2003 by Sugianto Halim with fellow ITS alumni. The company says seven ITS alumni founded it; only Sugianto Halim is named.

bareksa.note: Bareksa's own news pages name Karaniya Dharmasaputra as founder and CEO; other co-founders are not named in qualifying sources.

kreasipangan.note: Founded in 2018 as Kedai Sayur by Adrian Hernanto, Ahmad Supriyadi and Rizki Novian, per Tabloid Sinar Tani and youngster.id. It became Kedai Pangan Sejahtera in 2022 and Kreasi Pangan Samadhi in July 2025.

greenly.note: Founded by Edrick Joe Soetanto and Liana Gonta Widjaja, per East Ventures and Hybrid.co.id; Greenly opened its first outlet in Surabaya in 2019.

feedloop-ai.note: Co-founded by Ahmad Rizqi Meydiarso, Ronaldi Kurniawan Saphala and Muhammad Ajie Santika, per East Ventures, Hybrid.co.id and Muhammad Ajie Santika's own profile. Feedloop's site gives 2019 as its founding year; East Ventures and Hybrid.co.id say 2018.

mayar.note: Frianto Moerdowo is Mayar's co-founder and CEO, per Katadata and his own profile.

lokatani.note: Abdul Choliq is Lokatani's co-founder and CEO, per Techverse.asia and his own profile; the company traces its start to a home hydroponic garden he began.

crustea.note: Roikhanatun Nafi'ah is Crustea's founder and CEO, per Antara and her own profile. Other co-founders are not named in qualifying sources.

bahasa-ai.note: Hokiman Kurniawan co-founded Bahasa.ai in 2016, per East Ventures, and later launched Meeting.ai. Other co-founders are not named in qualifying sources.

bumiterra.note: Founded in 2022 by Tara Susanto and James Joseph, who sign the founders' letter on the company's About page.

bantubumi.note: Endra Marsudi is Bantubumi's founder and CEO, per Kompas and his own profile.

dicoding.note: Founded on 5 January 2015 by Narenda Wicaksono with co-founders Ash-Shidiqqul Akbar Hidayat and Kevin Kurniawan, per Dicoding's own blog.

sumopod.note: Ariaseta Setia Alam is named as SumoPod's founder by Dicoding (DevCoach workshop, 12 Sep 2025) and by AIClub Indonesia (Builder's Story, 9 Oct 2026). His own LinkedIn profile dates the role from May 2025; he previously led KodingWorks, the trading name of the company that operates SumoPod.

klar-smile.note: Ellen Pranata is CEO; Adelia Susanto is chief orthodontist; David Sugihartana is COO (AC Ventures' seed release, 29 Jun 2021, and TNGlobal, 29 Jun 2021). The seed announcement dates the launch to September 2020; the PT was established on 21 Jul 2020.

primaku.note: Didit is called founder (DailySocial) and co-founder (e27, AppWorks). AppWorks says the app began in 2017 as a doctors' CSR initiative and that Didit joined in 2021; the doctors behind the original app are not named, so no other co-founder is listed.

nexmedis.note: Three co-founders named in East Ventures' release and by DailySocial.

kulina.note: Bisnis (5 Oct 2026) names Andy Fajar Handika and Andy Hidayat as the builders of Kulina; Liputan6 (6 Mar 2018) and Kontan (17 Aug 2018) call Andy Fajar Handika its co-founder and founder; East Ventures' portfolio page lists the founder names Andy Hidayat and Fajar Handika. Liputan6 (6 Mar 2018) also calls Casper Sermsuksan a co-founder; he is left out because only one outlet names him so.

looyal.note: youngster.id names both founders; Katadata confirms Kevin Susanto Goly as co-founder and CEO. Supriadhi Wicaksono is named by one outlet only.

happyfresh.note: HappyFresh's own 2015 release names Markus Bihler as CEO and co-founder and says the company 'is led by Markus Bihler, Benjamin Koellmann and Fajar Budiprasetyo'; Tech in Asia (quoted by Post & Parcel, 14 Sep 2015) calls Benjamin Koellmann a co-founder. Only Bihler is confirmed as a founder by the company's own release; Guillem Segarra, chief executive from 2017, is not a founder.

cicil.note: East Ventures' release and Vertex Ventures' portfolio page name Leslie Lim and Edward Widjonarko as co-founders (youngster.id spells him Yohanes Edward Widjanarko). Bisnis (15 Aug 2018) also pictures Ricky Jeremiah among the founders; he is left out because only that caption names him.

amoda.note: East Ventures (2023) dates the founding to October 2021.

compawnion.note: The company site adds Eddie Amintohir as co-founder and CFO; East Ventures' 2023 release names the other three.

hukumku.note: The company site shortens the COO's name to Michael Jagad. The site says Hukumku has operated since 2023.

arsitag.note: Medcom names Michael Gani as CTO and Steven Gomedi as COO in the same article; the founding year 2015 is from the company's About page and LinkedIn.

pathgen.note: Dr. Susanti uses a single name (LinkedIn shows Susanti Susanti). Michael Rampangilei joined as co-founder in 2023.

fintelite.note: Hybrid.co.id names Nadia Amalia as co-founder and CEO, with Fransisca Susan (CTO) and Fadhila (COO); Forbes lists the three as cofounders. Y Combinator now lists only Nadia Amalia and Nadia Fadhila as active founders. The founding year 2020 is from Sribuu's own about page; Y Combinator gives 2021.

seindonesia.note: Trihill Capital, an investor, lists four co-founders on its portfolio page: Rinaldi Dharma Utama, Christian Wilfandio, Bayu Soedjarwo and Christian Nathanael. Rinaldi Dharma Utama, a former Kopi Kenangan executive, is named as CEO and co-founder by Tribun Jatim and Baliwara, and as founder by Insignia Ventures Partners (Apr 2025).

sirsak.note: All three co-founders are named on the company's own about page, which also gives 2023 as the founding year (confirmed by e27).

suryanesia.note: The company's own about page names Rheza Adhihusada as founder and CEO; TNGlobal (22 Dec 2022) gives the founding date as August 2021. Intudo's portfolio page also lists him as founder.

tiptip.note: Albert Lucius is named as TipTip's sole founder by its lead investor and by TechCrunch, The Business Times and TNGlobal on different hosts; he was still CEO in May 2026 and his LinkedIn profile gives his title as Group CEO and founder of TipTip.

alterra.note: Jefrey Joe also co-founded Alpha JWC Ventures, Sepulsa's backer (KrASIA, 9 Nov 2018). Ananto Wibisono was co-founder and CEO at the January 2019 rebrand to Alterra; the founders' current roles were not checked, and LinkedIn now lists Ayu Julien as Chief of Alterra Bills.

filmore.note: IDN Times (27 Jan 2022), Jakarta Daily (7 Sep 2022) and Tatler Asia (27 Jan 2023) name the same three founders; the first two are linked from Filmore's own press page. Gitta Amelia is Founder and CEO of Filmore Health in its November 2025 statements (Media Indonesia, 18 Nov 2025; Kompas advertorial, 20 Nov 2025), and the Kompas advertorial calls Grace Tahir a co-founder. Andrea Gunawan was quoted as a co-founder in 2022 and 2023; no 2026 source confirms her current role. The founding year 2022 follows the January 2022 launch; the company's November 2025 statement says 2023.

bang-jamin.note: Indra Baruna is co-founder and CEO; Andri Lau is named co-founder by the company's own LinkedIn page and CNBC Indonesia. 2022 is the PT's establishment year and Venturra's founding year; SBI Ven Capital says the platform launched in 2023. The site says the founding team has more than 30 years of insurance experience but names only Indra Baruna.

milikirumah.note: Kompas (6 Aug 2026) reports that Marine Novita stopped serving as president director in April 2026; she remains a co-founder in the earlier sources.

zahir.note: Spelled Basymeleh on the company blog and Besymeleh by IDX Channel. The company blog says he built the software with friends; no co-founder is named.

mceasy.note: Raymond Sutjiono is co-founder and CEO; Hendrik Ekowaluyo is named as co-founder by East Ventures (2022) and DailySocial (2025). The company's own release gives 2017 as the founding year.

mimin.note: Joseph Simbar is CEO and Bayu Eka Putra COO; both are called co-founders by youngster.id (9 Dec 2024), and TechShake (25 Aug 2026) names Bayu Eka Putra as co-founder. No source gives a founding year.

bizhare.note: Heinrich Vincent is founder and CEO, Giovanni Umboh CTO and Gatot Adhi Wibowo CFO at the time of the 21 Nov 2023 release (Bisnis.com caption, same day).

goro.note: Robert Hoving was co-founder and CEO at the 2023 round; by November 2025 Kontan calls Andryan Gouw co-founder and CEO. Robert Hoving's LinkedIn post of 15 Jul 2024 dates GORO's inception to 15 Jul 2022.

sembuh-ai.note: Claudio Perlini (CEO) is named as co-founder by both Iterative and Block71 (NUS Enterprise); David Jendra and Yosefraim Setiawan are named as founders by Iterative, the lead investor, only.

inspigo.note: Yoris Sebastian is named as Inspigo's founder-owner by Bisnis.com (27 Apr 2021) and IDN Times (5 Sep 2018); Bisnis.com names Tyo Guritno as CEO. The three-founder list (Tyo Guritno, Yoris Sebastian, Eva Ditasari) comes from a 2021 Universitas Multimedia Nusantara internship report quoting the company, which is weaker than press; Tyo Guritno and Eva Ditasari as co-founders rest on that report.

danamart.note: Sindonews (31 Mar 2020) calls Patrick Gunadi 'CEO dan Co Founder', so there may be other co-founders, but none is named.

gradana.note: The AFPI member profile lists William Susilo Yunior and Angela S. Oetama as CEO; founding date 7 Nov 2016 per AFPI.

ipaymu.note: The company's about page names Riyeke Ustadiyanto (known as Keke) as founder and CEO. A tracker also names Dicky Sukmana as co-founder; no company or press source confirms that, so he is not listed.

konstruksi-ai.note: The site lists the three as Co-Founder & CEO, CPO and CTO. Antler's January 2024 release also named Daniel Tjandra in the team; he is not on the current site, so he is not listed as a founder here.

onlinepajak.note: Founder named in two press outlets (Digital News Asia, AVCJ) in October 2018; no 2026 source on his current role was checked.

tada.note: Endeavor Indonesia and Venturra (an investor) both name him as founder, and Hybrid (June 2013) reported his launch of the TaDa! gift card. The company's own pages checked do not name a founder.

floq.note: FLOQ's own site and releases name only Yudhono Rawis as founder (founder and CEO since January 2025 per his LinkedIn profile). Timothy Ronald and Kalimasada are named as co-founders by Techverse (8 Jun 2026) and Investortrust (18 Apr 2025), and Timothy Ronald also by Media Indonesia (7 Jun 2026); Timothy Ronald's own LinkedIn profile lists him as co-owner of FLOQ since April 2025.

sokratech.note: Founded by Brian Lee, a former data scientist at Shopee, OVO and GoCardless, per Tech in Asia (9 Mar 2026), which names him CEO and founder; Sokratech's official LinkedIn page calls him "our Founder" (19 Aug 2026). His own LinkedIn profile lists him as co-founder and CEO since April 2024. No source names any other founder.

momofin.note: Gregorius Yoga Pratama (Yoga Pratama), co-founder and CFO, is the one founder named in every account. Coverage of its 2022 launch (DailySocial, reposted on Momofin's own blog, and FinTech Global) says Momofin was founded in early 2022 by Pranowo Putro, Saga Iqranegara and Yoga Pratama, while investor Tenity (Jul 2025) and Tech in Asia (Jan 2026) name Rorian Pratyaksa, Darell Hoei and Gregorius Yoga Pratama as the co-founders; Rorian Pratyaksa was reported in 2022 as an angel investor in Momofin's first round. Because the accounts disagree, only the name they share is recorded.

peris-ai.note: Co-founded by David Samuel (CEO) and Deden Gobel (CTO), per East Ventures' February 2023 funding announcement and its portfolio page, and fintech.global (2 Feb 2023); Liputan6 (17 Sep 2026) also calls David Samuel co-founder and CEO. LinkedIn gives 2022 as the founding year.

prospero-solutions.note: Founded by Bobby Yulandika Putra, founder and CEO, per UIII (18 May 2026) and APAC Entrepreneur (22 May 2025); Paul-Adrian Mandravel joined in 2025 as co-founder and CTO, per the company's LinkedIn page and UIII, and Founders Magazine (Sep 2025) calls Prospero founded by Bobby and Paul. The company's LinkedIn page gives 2016 as the founding year and its PT was incorporated in Nov 2016, while UIII says Bobby started Prospero as a solo venture in 2022.

restock-id.note: Co-founded in 2019 by Muhammad Farid Andika, co-founder and CEO until April 2021, per Hybrid/DailySocial (3 Feb 2021) and CNBC Indonesia (3 Apr 2021), and Rega Sardjono, co-founder and now a director, per Hybrid/DailySocial (3 Feb 2021) and Kontan (1 Dec 2025); his own LinkedIn profile lists him as co-founder of RestockID since 2019.

assemblr.note: Founded in 2018 by Hasbi Asyadiq (founder and CEO) with co-founders Anita Yustisia (CCO) and Risnandar (CTO), per the company's blog (Feb 2021) and Katadata (Dec 2022); the company says it became a separate entity in July 2018 after starting as a 2017 prototype. Gaby Wantah, now COO, has been described as a co-founder since 2025 (a Women's Tabloid interview, Oct 2025, which the company's LinkedIn page reposted, and her own LinkedIn profile), but the company's own pages and the press about its founding do not name her, so she is not recorded here.

lentera-app.note: Founded by Annastasia Puspaningtyas, founder and CEO, per the company's own launch article (Sept 2023); Hypeabis (Oct 2025) and a KepoBuku podcast (Sept 2025) also call her the founder. Her LinkedIn profile dates her founder role at PT Lentera Metamesta Nusantara to October 2021; the company itself gives no founding year. She also goes by Anna Puspaningtyas.

doctortool.note: Founded in 2015 by Rainaldo (CEO), Septu Jamasoka (CTO) and Elisa Yoshigoe Wijaya (CCO), who are named as co-founders on the company's About page, in its company profile and in its March 2024 press release; Fortune Indonesia gives the 2015 founding year. Rainaldo uses a single name. The chairman and chief medical officer, dr. Gatot Soetono, is not described as a founder.
